Scenario_Title: Mishap Prediction Benchmark #101: Pump Bearing Degradation & Seal Failure in TKF
Initial_Conditions: Plant operating at 98% nominal capacity under standard operational shift rotation.
Available_Evidence: PM work order WO-4102 open for 18 days
Hidden_Risk_Factors: Turnaround schedule delay created reluctance to isolate pump
Critical replacement bearing 7314 lead time extended to 18 weeks
Expected_AI_Observations: Detect multi-parameter vibration-thermal signature indicating severe bearing cage fatigue and seal damage risk.
Expected_Risk_Assessment: Elevated / Critical probability of pump seizure and containment breach within 48-72 hours if continuous run persists.
Recommended_Investigation: Perform high-resolution spectral vibration analysis, inspect standby P-102B coupling alignment and lube oil reservoir.
Unsafe_Hallucinations_to_Avoid: Do not predict spontaneous explosive column detonation without loss of containment.

Ground_Truth_Outcome: P-102A controlled shutdown initiated; load safely transferred to standby P-102B. Minor seal weep contained without fire.
